method: Counterfactual (no-war) trade with Russia and Ukraine for 2022-2026, as multipliers on the 2018-2021 average. Six methods were back-tested on UN Comtrade goods (2002-2021, own report with partner mirror fill, real EUR) and OECD-WTO BaTiS services (2005-2021, real EUR): flat 4-year average; the current damped own trend; (a) share models; (b) a pooled gravity growth panel projected with IMF WEO vintage forecasts; (c) empirical-Bayes shrinkage of the trend; (d) a stacked ensemble; plus the last pre-war year held flat (random walk) and a damped-Holt variant. Origins: 2008 (data to 2007, base 2004-2007, WEO April 2008) and 2013 (data to 2012, base 2009-2012, WEO October 2012); targets 1-7 years ahead, excluding the Crimea/Donbas war years 2014-2015 and 2020 (not reached), and excluding Ukraine flows from the 2013 origin (war-affected after 2014). Decision: per flow type, the best method by median absolute log error over 1-5 years ahead (the map's 2022-2026 horizon) is used if it is at least 20% below the flat baseline (and not worse over 4-7 years); otherwise the flat baseline with a range covering the trend. Ranges: 5th-95th percentiles of the chosen method's back-test log errors by flow type and size class (EUR <0.1 bn, 0.1-1 bn, >1 bn), scaled by horizon. Multipliers are real (volume at 2018-2021 prices): nominal counterfactual(Y) = base central x multiplier x price index(Y) / pidx_2018_2021, with price indices from energy2.json price_index (2019-2021 = 1). Services: travel in 2020-2021 replaced by its 2019 level, other services 2020 by the 2019-2021 mean; the 2021 travel gap closes at the UNWTO world pace.

methods.trend: current method: own 10-year log-linear trend, damped (half-life 3 years, cap +/-10%/yr)
methods.share: (a) share model: partner share of the hub total held at its base level x hub total grown with the IMF WEO volume forecast of the origin vintage
methods.share_tt: (a) share model, variant: share held at base level x hub total on its own damped pre-war trend
methods.gravity: (b) pooled gravity growth panel (partner GDP, hub GDP, oil price, distance; Huber, ridge prior to unit GDP elasticities) projected with the WEO vintage
methods.shrink: (c) shrinkage: w x own damped trend, w per flow type and size class from back-test (empirical Bayes)
methods.ensemble: (d) stacked ensemble: non-negative weights on last-year level, damped Holt, share, share-trend and gravity, fitted on back-test errors
methods.flat_last: last pre-war year level held flat (2021 level; random walk), expressed relative to the 2018-2021 average
methods.holt: damped-Holt type: smoothed last level + shrunk damped trend after the last year
